subject.title: fix(agents): keep multimodal models when generated catalogs include audio/video inputs

question: Should this PR be the canonical landing path for the generated catalog audio/video input bug, or should the broader catalog-core/discovery preservation from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97858 be included first?
rationale: Multiple same-root PRs exist and the permanent breadth of audio/video as accepted provider model input metadata is compatibility-sensitive maintainer scope.

options.title: Land this smaller proven fix
options.body: Accept this PR as the canonical fix for the reported registry/list fallback path and track any broader catalog preservation separately.

options.title: Port broader preservation first
options.body: Bring the sibling PR's catalog-core/discovery/static-catalog preservation into one canonical branch before merge.

options.title: Reject widening and clamp catalogs
options.body: Replace the widening approach with generated-catalog normalization that drops unsupported modalities before registry validation.

recommendation.title: Land this smaller proven fix
recommendation.body: Accept this PR as the canonical fix for the reported registry/list fallback path and track any broader catalog preservation separately.
